Definition: Chavran, a region East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Hauran is named in Ezekiel's vision as a borderland of the restored land, lying between Damascus and Hamath on the north and measured again on the east side. It marks the edge of the country God draws for His people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God draws the borders of the restored land with the same care as the first. Hauran is on the map He gives Ezekiel, and the promise is drawn in full.
